verdict.rationale: RUN documents its own online payroll reporting that users can view, customize and print. It also documents exporting payroll journal entries to accounting tools or a generic output file, which partly covers exporting data for analysis. Payroll registers and gross-to-net reports are never named, and export of reports (rather than journal entries) is not documented. Missing for 10: explicit payroll register and gross-to-net report types, documented report export formats (e.g., CSV/Excel), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can generate payroll registers and gross-to-net reports and export them for analysis

citations.quote: View, access, customize and print payroll and HR reports online.
Export journal entries from ADP into QuickBooks®, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions or a generic output file without re-keying data.
Streamline payroll and HR with multi-company reports, tax forms, workforce analytics, and more.
